insights.one_liner: Has 12 open jobs in Amsterdam, mostly IT and consulting and largely in English, but is not an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: All 12 open jobs are in Amsterdam, split between IT, cloud and security (5) and consulting and strategy (5), including 2 internships.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so it cannot sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa directly.
83% of its 12 jobs here don't require Dutch; none mention visa support.
